args.text:
Batch: 25 runs. 14 accepted, 11 declined (r03, r05, r06, r07, r08, r13, r17, r19, r21, r22, r24) and none not_reported.
Flagged: none.
Cleared: all 14 accepted runs (r01, r02, r04, r09, r10, r11, r12, r14, r15, r16, r18, r20, r23, r25). On every one, each check that was run passed. Every centre-REGR peak is at 316 µm, and growth-zone lengths are 526–547 µm.
- r02, r04, r10 and r20 have centre-REGR peaks of about 84 %/h, roughly twice the batch median of 42.44 %/h. Their peak position, growth-zone length and flank-difference size match the batch, and their kept remedies are a stride change from 6 to 3 to 1, plus registration in r02 and r04. A stride change doesn't rescale the rate, so these are taken as faster roots. All four ran the same stride path, so it's worth a spot check against the frame times.
- r09, r11, r14, r15 and r25 were reported with the width-free ratio, so plane sections was not run. The large |z| on r11 and r14 comes from a very small batch MAD (0.005). Their ratios differ from the median by only about 0.025.
What flagged runs have in common: not applicable, since no runs were flagged.
